title: lens esculenta var. schnittspahnii
intro: Lens esculenta var. schnittspahnii, commonly known as the Indian butter bean or chich-pea, is a variety of the Lens esculenta plant, a type of legume native to the Indian subcontinent. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lens esculenta var. schnittspahnii include its antidiabetic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Research has also identified other beneficial compounds, including lectins and phytosterols, which contribute to the plant's therapeutic potential.
